assumptions: NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0's rpstblastn against the bundled SMART PSSMs, with the genetic code given.
limits: SMART's 1,011 models only; all of CDD is rps_blast_cdd.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which SMART domains does this DNA encode in any of its six frames?

description: rpstblastn, run on this machine: find conserved domains in DNA by searching all six reading frames against NCBI's SMART domain models (1,011 PSSMs from CDD). Leave `sequence` empty to search the open record. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0's algorithms, checked against the rpstblastn program on every bundled GenBank record. Nothing is sent anywhere; for all of CDD use rps_blast_cdd on a translated protein.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

comp_based_stats.description: composition-based statistics: 1 on (the default, Schäffer et al. 2001), 0 off.

evalue.description: report alignments with E at most this (`-evalue`); BLAST's default is 10.

genetic_code.description: NCBI genetic code used to translate the six frames (`-query_gencode`).

sequence.description: the DNA to search, 5′→3′; leave empty to search the open record. Both strands are searched.

source.description: where the SMART database is read from: 'bundled' (a byte-identical copy of NCBI's file) or 'ncbi' (NCBI's FTP site, now). Advanced.

name: rpstblastn_smart

domains.description: every SMART domain hit, best first: accession, shortName, title, profileLength and each HSP's nucleotide coordinates (1-based, to < from on the minus strand) and frame, model coordinates, score, bits, E-value, identities, positives, gaps and aligned strings
